policy: Distinct physical Place IDs are never merged or assigned each other's coordinates, shrine status, relic claims, liturgical schedules or visitor availability.

relationships.description_en: Both are distinct chapels within the Kevelaer pilgrimage precinct at Kapellenplatz.
relationships.description_fr: Deux chapelles distinctes du sanctuaire de pèlerinage de Kevelaer, sur la Kapellenplatz.
relationships.source_label: St. Marien Kevelaer — Kerzenkapelle and Gnadenkapelle

relationships.description_en: The parish church at 15 Well Street and St Winefride’s Shrine & Well on Greenfield Street are separately addressed sites associated by the shrine's official parish guidance.
relationships.description_fr: L’église paroissiale du 15 Well Street et le sanctuaire avec la source de sainte Winefride, Greenfield Street, sont deux lieux distincts reliés par les indications officielles du sanctuaire.
